svg.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 text encode on Apple M5 Pro: tessl d8f9cc3 against sentence-transformers 6.1.0 on torch 2.14.1 MPS; the two workloads torch cannot fit in 32 GiB left out (4 interleaved rounds)
svg.text: EmbeddingGemma 2 text encode on Apple M5 Pro: tessl d8f9cc3 against sentence-transformers 6.1.0 on torch 2.14.1 MPS; the two workloads torch cannot fit in 32 GiB left out (4 interleaved rounds)

Left: each lane's median over rounds of its min-of-N encode time, log scale. Middle: speed-up against the first lane (1 / the median per-round ratio, whiskers at the lowest and highest round). Right: device peak above the loaded model.
